tools.name: search_resorts
tools.description: Search the Maldives accommodation catalog by name, atoll, star class, transfer mode, meal plan and experience. Results list resorts before guesthouses and are not a ranking by quality. Can also narrow to a short transfer from the airport or to stays with a 360° tour. Returns compact summaries.

tools.name: resolve_resort
tools.description: Turn a loosely-written resort name into its canonical slug and a confidence score. Handles the real-world drift between how a resort is written and how it is stored — "Soneva Fushi" vs "SonevaFushi", "ONE&ONLY" vs "One & Only", missing or extra suffix words. tools.name: get_resort
tools.description: Full record for one property: location, transfers, meal plans, room/dining counts, policies, sustainability, brand detail, a few photographs and its 360° tour when published. Optionally attaches the child catalogues (villas, dining, spa, dive, experiences) in the same call.

tools.name: list_villas
tools.description: Room and villa categories for a resort: size, occupancy, bed config, view, overwater/pool/beach flags and inclusions. Pricing is excluded.

tools.name: list_dining
tools.description: Restaurants and bars at a resort: cuisine, style, setting, dress code, signature dishes. Pricing and priced menu documents are excluded.

tools.name: list_spas
tools.description: Spa and wellness facilities: operating brand, setting, treatment rooms, couples suites, signature treatments and specialties.

tools.name: list_dive_centres
tools.description: Dive operations: operator, PADI level, courses, instructor languages, house reef quality, named dive sites and the marine life encountered there.

tools.name: list_experiences
tools.description: Activities and excursions offered at a resort: type, category, duration, what is included and any age restriction.

tools.name: compare_resorts
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-6 properties on a fixed attribute set (location, transfers, scale, board, tier, experience tags).

tools.name: similar_resorts
tools.description: Nearest alternatives to a given property, matched on atoll, tier, transfer mode and experience profile.

tools.name: list_atolls
tools.description: The Maldives atolls carrying accommodation, with resort counts and lagoon centroid coordinates. Optionally includes each atoll's resort roster.

tools.name: catalog_stats
tools.description: How much of the Maldives this catalog actually covers — visible property count and atoll count.

tools.name: get_resort_gallery
tools.description: Photography for one property, in the site's own display order (editor's primary pick first, then owned bucket imagery). Returns direct image URLs with category and photo credit where recorded.

tools.name: list_vr_tours
tools.description: Every resort with a published self-hosted 360° virtual tour, with scene counts and a thumbnail. Only returns tours that are live on the site.

tools.name: get_vr_tour
tools.description: The scene graph for one published 360° tour: every panorama with its title, category and panorama image URLs: what a guest can walk through before booking.

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: What is close to a named place on the Maldives map: resorts, guesthouses, dive sites, surf breaks and restaurants at other properties, nearest first, with a mix of kinds and straight-line distance. Distance is not travel time.

tools.name: list_dive_sites
tools.description: Named dive and snorkel sites with depth, skill level, current, best season and the species seen there. Coordinates appear only when the exact position has been verified. These are sites, not resort dive centres.

tools.name: get_dive_site
tools.description: Full record for one dive site, including its description, photo with credit, protected status and marine-welfare guidance.

tools.name: list_surf_breaks
tools.description: Named surf breaks with a verified position: wave type, skill level, best season, hazards and the nearest property.

tools.name: when_to_see
tools.description: Where and in which months to see an animal in the Maldives: manta rays, whale sharks, turtles, hammerheads and others.
